name: tinygres
author: jamesgpearce

scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run build && npm run test:wasm:built && npm run check:size
scripts.check:release: npm run check:source && npm run build && npm run test:wasm:contract && npm run check:size && npm run test:browser:built && npm run test:package:built
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:built
scripts.test:wasm: npm run build:wasm && npm run test:wasm:built
scripts.test:wasm:built: npm run test:wasm:contract && playwright test test/browser/paged-memory.spec.ts

description: A tiny, worker-first relational database for browser apps.
